nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement Ferryx daemon protocol v2 and daemon runtime behavior required for persistent terminal ownership, with RED-to-GREEN Rust tests.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/daemon/protocol.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/server.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/client.rs, and src-tauri/src/daemon/mod.rs if required. Build on the existing sequenced TerminalOutputHub. Implement: protocol version 2; daemon epoch in handshake/list/attach metadata; DescribeSession; Spawn requiring clientRequestId and optional validated cwd; spawn idempotency cache; Attach with afterSequence; an attachment-specific UDS stream that does NOT monopolize the persistent control connection; sequenced Output and replay-gap frames; typed client APIs for list/describe/spawn/attach/write/resize/signal/close. Remove in-process direct DaemonServer fallback from production client behavior; launch external ferryx --daemon binary with a bounded readiness mechanism or return explicit error when unavailable. Do not depend on GUI state. Add tests before production code that fail under v1/current one-connection attach semantics.
SCOPE: You own only the four daemon files. Read terminal output hub and main.rs for contracts. Do not edit lib.rs, ipc/, remote/, tests outside daemon module, or UI. Do not commit or revert unrelated edits.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml daemon:: --lib and cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. Both must exit 0. Report RED/GREEN commands, exact tests, changed files, and unresolved handoff requirements.
STOP WHEN: Protocol v2, dedicated attachment streams, idempotent spawn, explicit daemon connection behavior, and unit evidence are complete in owned files only.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Replace GUI-owned terminal runtime access with DaemonClient-only Tauri terminal IPC, using RED-to-GREEN Rust tests.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/lib.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/terminal.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/project.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/tests.rs, and src-tauri/src/ipc/blocking_contract_tests.rs when required. The daemon protocol/typed APIs are being produced in a parallel lane; depend only on its stated contract and adapt after it is available. Remove GUI-managed PtyManager, TerminalOutputHub, and TerminalService; manage DaemonClient instead. Route spawn/list/describe/attach/write/resize/signal/close through it. Register project/workspace with the daemon before spawn and preserve existing GUI layout persistence. Emit one sequenced Tauri output pump per backend session, abort/reuse prior attachment pump to prevent duplicates, and pass typed daemon errors through (no direct fallback). Remote commands must use daemon-owned terminal service through the client/proxy boundary. Write tests first that demonstrate the old direct state is present or attach unavailable, then make them green.
SCOPE: Own exactly the listed lib/ipc files. Read daemon protocol/client and remote state only for API contracts; do not edit daemon/terminal/UI files. Do not commit or revert unrelated changes.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml ipc:: --lib, cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test ipc_hardening_contract, and cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. All must exit 0. Report RED/GREEN evidence, changed files, and any API mismatch blocking integration.
STOP WHEN: Tauri no longer owns PTY runtime state and all terminal operations are daemon-client routed with tests passing.
